summary: CSLM Digital Asset Acquisition Corp III (Nasdaq: KOYN), a Cayman SPAC, disclosed an October 6, 2026 business combination agreement with Gibraltar-based First Digital Group Ltd. The deal runs a three-step de-SPAC structure: First Digital re-domiciles to the Cayman Islands, KOYN merges into PubCo (CSLM III Holdings Ltd), then Merger Sub merges into First Digital, which survives as a wholly-owned PubCo subsidiary. Outstanding KOYN units, Class A shares and warrants convert in the reincorporation merger. No price, stake, premium, close date, advisor or board recommendation is stated in the excerpt, leaving redemption levels and any minimum-cash condition the key arbitrage variables.
